notes.title: Update: Typo and Glitch Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed some issues with typos.

Eliminated some glitches that were occurring with the Ren'Py engine.

notes.title: New update: Achievements
notes.notes:
[h1]New update![/h1]

Major feature is 5 new Steam achievements to collect. Play the game multiple times to try and unlock everything.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Added Steam Achievements
[*] Updated main menu to make Reset button more clear
[*] Removed problematic save and loading
[*] Fixed an issue with the back button going too far
[/list]
